baseline_best_centered_pose.conclusion: No rigid centred level pose fits the inherited wheel meridian: outer shoulder already exceeds R75 with zero centre offset.

derived_supported_pose.derivation: pipe_z = wheel_z - crown_radius + sqrt(pipe_radius^2-wheel_center_y^2); paired lower-wall crown contacts support gravity with symmetric lateral reactions.

nonwheel_integrated_mesh_screen.method: All vertices of the archived assembly mesh; no surrogate boxes.
nonwheel_integrated_mesh_screen.mesh_limit: Master tessellation tolerance .25 mm; a discrete surface screen, not exact BRep containment.

limits: Nominal rigid, straight circular ID150 pipe, level crawler, static lift LOW only.
Wheel outer contour is an engineering estimate, not a recovered OEM QRW90 profile.
Tyre deformation, loading/contact stress, wear, traction and tolerances not qualified.
No curved-pipe, joint/obstacle, full-lift or endurance/pressure test claimed.
Rebuild full CAD with proposed profile and contact-derived pose, rerun all-pair collision and STEP checks before adopting.

nonwheel_bounding_box_containment.method: Every YZ corner of each kernel bounding box, expanded by0.00001mm for registry rounding. Cylinder cross-section is convex, so contained corners prove the entire box and solid are contained.
